task: Repair a squeaky or soft subfloor spot
steps: Access the area from below (basement/crawlspace) if possible.
Look for gaps between the subfloor and joist, or signs of water damage/rot.
For a gap, apply construction adhesive and drive screws up through a cleat into the subfloor.
For soft/rotted sections, the damaged subfloor must be cut out and replaced - consider a pro.
From above, breakaway screws can pull down a squeaky spot without ceiling access.
